children: Grades broadly fell on Tuesday, dealers said, as Gulf oil flows recovered somewhat and refinery outages weighed on demand.

Gulf oil flows excluding Iran surged in September to over 81% of pre-war levels, data showed, led by a recovery in Saudi exports despite attacks on the kingdom's oil infrastructure and escalating Iranian attacks on regional shipping, while Iranian exports fell to zero due to a US blockade.

Venezuela's Cardon refinery, the country's second-largest with a 310,000-barrel-per-day capacity, was halted due to a fire at one of its processing units, eight sources with knowledge of the matter said on Tuesday.
Russia's Volgograd oil refinery halted crude oil processing completely on October 2 after equipment was damaged by a drone attack, two industry sources told Reuters on Tuesday.
The stoppage will likely exacerbate a fuel crunch in Russia caused by the attacks on refineries.
Light Louisiana Sweet (WTC-LLS) for November delivery fell 50 cents to a midpoint of a $1.75 premium and was seen bid and offered between a $1.65 and $1.85 a barrel premium to US crude futures
Mars Sour (WTC-MRS) fell $1.50 to a midpoint of a 50-cent discount and was seen bid and offered between a 60-cent and 40-cent a barrel discount to US crude futures
WTI Midland  (WTC-WTM) fell 10 cents to a midpoint of a 35-cent premium and was seen bid and offered between a 25-cent and 45-cent a barrel premium to U.S. crude futures
West Texas Sour (WTC-WTS) rose 10 cents to a midpoint of a $2.35 discount and was seen bid and offered between a $2.45 and $2.25 a barrel discount to US crude futures
WTI at East Houston (WTC-MEH), also known as MEH, traded between a 65-cent and 85-cent a barrel premium to US crude futures
rose 26 cents to settle at $100.58 a barrel on Tuesday​.
